note: Nomination-day report for the fifteen divisions of Lisburn rural district, one member each. Eight divisions received a single nomination and are listed here; in six further divisions no nomination was made and the retiring members were deemed re-elected, but their names were not printed. Ballyscolly was contested by Mr. Robert Beckett and Mr. Samuel Buchanan, and the result of that poll was not traced. The round is filed on the rural districts' polling day in early June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
